:::{#exr-scalar-mult-practice}
#### Converting a matrix of measurements from metres to centimetres

Converting measurements from metres to centimetres multiplies each one by $100$,
so converting every entry of a [matrix](#def-matrix) that holds them is a [scalar multiplication](#def-scalar-mult).
Let

$$
\matr{A} = \sbmat{1.5 & 0.2 \\ 0.75 & 2}
$$

hold measurements in metres.

Find $100\matr{A}$,
the same measurements in centimetres.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

By @def-scalar-mult,
multiply each entry of $\matr{A}$ by $100$.

:::

:::
